# NimTube

> Pure Client-Side YouTube Studio & Downloader. Download YouTube videos and audio at full quality (4K, 1080p, MP3) directly in your browser with yt-dlp & WebAssembly. Zero server bandwidth, 100% your IP.

## Features

- [Video Downloader](https://nimtube.2615.us/): Download videos up to 4K 60fps directly on the client-side.
- [Audio Extractor](https://nimtube.2615.us/): Extract and convert audio to MP3, AAC, or WAV locally.
- [NimTube Bridge](https://nimtube.2615.us/?view=extension): Companion Chrome extension to download directly using your own IP address without server limits.

## Technology

- [Technical Architecture](https://nimtube.2615.us/?view=how-it-works): In-depth breakdown of Innertube API, 4x parallel workers, and client-side streaming.
- [WebAssembly Core](https://nimtube.2615.us/?view=how-it-works): High-performance client-side media multiplexing with FFmpeg WebAssembly (-c copy).
